title: Sensor out of hard range
equation: Any modeled sensor reads outside its physical hard range (e.g. OAT −60–130°F, SAT 30–150°F, CHWS 30–80°F).
summary: Flags any modeled sensor reading outside its physical hard range.

title: Sensor flatline (stuck)
equation: Sensor value unchanged (Δ ≤ tolerance) across the flatline window — stuck / frozen sensor.
summary: Flags a sensor that stays stuck within a tiny band for too long.

title: Sensor rate-of-change spike
equation: Sample-to-sample jump exceeds the physical spike limit for the sensor type.
summary: Flags an implausible sample-to-sample jump for the sensor type.

title: Stale data (no fresh samples)
equation: All modeled sensors unchanged over the stale window — data feed likely dropped.
summary: Flags when all modeled sensors stop updating — likely a dead data feed.

title: Context-aware sensor rate of change
equation: Implausible sustained rate-of-change for mapped sensors. Thresholds depend on quantity, location, and operating state (steady vs startup/shutdown transient). Engineering screening defaults — tune per site. Alias: SV-SLEW. Distinct from SV-SPIKE (one-sample jump), SV-RANGE, SV-FLATLINE, and PID-HUNT-1.
summary: Flags implausible sustained sensor rates of change using location- and state-aware thresholds.

title: Suspected control-output hunting
equation: Rolling 1h total variation of any 0–100% control output (dampers, valves, fan speeds, heat/cool cmds) with span ≥20%, TV ≥500 %·pts, ≥2.5 equivalent cycles, ≥4 reversals — suspected loop hunting (not proof of bad PID alone).
summary: Flags control outputs that oscillate enough to suggest loop hunting.

title: Duct static below SP at full fan (GL36 A)
equation: DSP < DSPSP − εDSP AND VFDSPD ≥ 100% − εVFDSPD.
summary: Flags duct static too low while the supply fan is near full speed.

title: MAT below OAT/RAT envelope (GL36 B)
equation: MATavg + εMAT < min(RATavg − εRAT, OATavg − εOAT).
summary: Flags mixed-air temperature colder than the OAT/RAT mixing envelope allows.

params.label: OAT sensor error εOAT (GL36 default 2°F local / 5°F global)
Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: MAT above OAT/RAT envelope (GL36 C)
equation: MATavg − εMAT > max(RATavg + εRAT, OATavg + εOAT).
summary: Flags mixed-air temperature warmer than the OAT/RAT mixing envelope allows.

params.label: OAT sensor error εOAT (GL36 default 2°F local / 5°F global)
Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: PID hunting (operating-state oscillation)
equation: ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the prior 60-minute moving window.
summary: ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the prior 60-minute moving window.

title: SAT cold when heating commanded (GL36 D)
equation: SATavg + εSAT ≤ MATavg − εMAT + ΔTSF while heating is commanded.
summary: SATavg + εSAT ≤ MATavg − εMAT + ΔTSF while heating is commanded.

params.label: Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: Estimated OA fraction mismatch
equation: |RATavg−OATavg| ≥ ΔTmin AND |estimated OA% − design min OA%| > εF.
summary: |RATavg−OATavg| ≥ ΔTmin AND |estimated OA% − design min OA%| > εF.

title: SAT low with full heating (GL36 E)
equation: SATavg < SATSP − εSAT AND HC ≥ full-heating threshold.
summary: SATavg < SATSP − εSAT AND HC ≥ full-heating threshold.

title: SAT/MAT mismatch in economizer (GL36 F)
equation: |SATavg − ΔTSF − MATavg| > √(εSAT² + εMAT²) in OS#2.
summary: |SATavg − ΔTSF − MATavg| > √(εSAT² + εMAT²) in OS#2.

params.label: Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: OAT too warm for free cooling (GL36 G)
equation: OATavg − εOAT > SATSP − ΔTSF + εSAT in OS#2.
summary: OATavg − εOAT > SATSP − ΔTSF + εSAT in OS#2.

params.label: OAT sensor error εOAT (GL36 default 2°F local / 5°F global)
Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: OAT/MAT mismatch + mech cooling (GL36 H)
equation: |MATavg − OATavg| > √(εMAT² + εOAT²) in OS#3.
summary: |MATavg − OATavg| > √(εMAT² + εOAT²) in OS#3.

params.label: OAT sensor error εOAT (GL36 default 2°F local / 5°F global)
Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: OAT/MAT mismatch economizer-only (GL36 I)
equation: OATavg + εOAT < SATSP − ΔTSF − εSAT in OS#3.
summary: OATavg + εOAT < SATSP − ΔTSF − εSAT in OS#3.

params.label: OAT sensor error εOAT (GL36 default 2°F local / 5°F global)
Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: SAT above blend in cooling (GL36 J)
equation: SATavg − εSAT − ΔTSF ≥ MATavg + εMAT in OS#3/OS#4.
summary: SATavg − εSAT − ΔTSF ≥ MATavg + εMAT in OS#3/OS#4.

params.label: Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: SAT above SP at full cooling (GL36 K)
equation: SATavg > SATSP + εSAT AND CC ≥ full-cooling threshold in OS#3/OS#4.
summary: SATavg > SATSP + εSAT AND CC ≥ full-cooling threshold in OS#3/OS#4.

title: CHW coil ΔT when inactive (GL36 L)
equation: Cooling-coil ΔT ≥ √(εCCET² + εCCLT²) + ΔTSF while coil should be inactive.
summary: Cooling-coil ΔT ≥ √(εCCET² + εCCLT²) + ΔTSF while coil should be inactive.

params.label: Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: HW coil ΔT when inactive (GL36 M)
equation: Heating-coil ΔT ≥ √(εHCET² + εHCLT²) + ΔTSF while coil should be inactive.
summary: Heating-coil ΔT ≥ √(εHCET² + εHCLT²) + ΔTSF while coil should be inactive.

params.label: Legacy master sensor tolerance (sets all ε values)

title: SAT deviation from setpoint
equation: |SAT − SAT SP| > 5°F.
summary: |SAT − SAT SP| > 5°F.

title: Duct static pressure high
equation: Duct static > static SP + margin. Evaluates when fan is proven on OR duct static itself exceeds pressure_on_min (catches high static with fan-status off).
summary: Duct static > static SP + margin.

title: Heating and cooling simultaneous
equation: Heating valve > 10% AND cooling valve > 10% at once.
summary: Heating valve > 10% AND cooling valve > 10% at once.

title: BAS outdoor-air sensor vs Open-Meteo
equation: BAS OAT sensor differs from Open-Meteo dry bulb by more than 5°F.
summary: Flags large disagreement between BAS outdoor-air temp and web weather OAT.

title: Economizer stuck closed
equation: Fan on, OA damper < 5%, OAT > 55°F (should be economizing).
summary: Fan on, OA damper < 5%, OAT > 55°F (should be economizing).

title: Economizing when outdoor unfavorable
equation: OAT > 63°F AND OA damper > 42% (should be at minimum).
summary: OAT > 63°F AND OA damper > 42% (should be at minimum).

title: Mech cooling without integrated economizer
equation: Web free-cooling opportunity: 60°F ≤ dry-bulb < 72°F AND dewpoint < 60°F (dewpoint from web sensor or calculated from web DB+RH). Fault when cooling valve is open while OA damper is below the integrated-economizer threshold (default 90%). No BAS OAT fallback. Screenable engineering defaults — not code limits.
summary: Flags mechanical cooling during web free-cool weather when the OA damper is not fully integrated.

title: Low estimated OA fraction
equation: Fan on, |RAT−OAT| > 2.2°F, estimated OA fraction < 21%.
summary: Fan on, |RAT−OAT| > 2.2°F, estimated OA fraction < 21%.

title: Preheat over-conditioning
equation: Preheat leaving air > 1.2°C above target while preheat active.
summary: Preheat leaving air > 1.2°C above target while preheat active.

title: Economizing in freezing weather
equation: Web dry-bulb < 25°F AND OA damper above winter min-OA ceiling (default 25%). AHU should be at minimum OA in cold weather.
summary: Flags an AHU economizing above min-OA when web outdoor air is below freezing (25°F).

title: Economizer OK but not economizing
equation: Economizer-OK web weather: dew point < 60°F AND dry-bulb < 72°F (above a 35°F freeze-guard floor; dewpoint from web sensor or calculated from web DB+RH). Fault when there is cooling demand (cooling valve open or proven DX/chiller cooling) but the OA damper stays below the economizing threshold (default 50%). Expected: economizer-only below 60°F DB (MECH-OAT-1) and mech + integrated economizer in the 60–72°F band (ECON-3). All thresholds are imperial sliders.
summary: Flags cooling demand during economizer-OK web weather (dew point < 60°F, dry-bulb < 72°F) while the OA damper is not economizing.

title: Mechanical cooling below 60°F web OAT
equation: Proven DX/chiller mechanical cooling while web dry-bulb < 15.6°C. Uses compressor/chiller/pump/amps/power proof — not AHU cooling-valve alone. Below 60°F is outside the free-cool + integrated economizer band.
summary: Flags proven DX or chiller cooling while web dry-bulb is below 60°F.

title: Chiller running with no building load
equation: Chiller/plant proven running while building load is satisfied: all mapped zones inside comfort band OR all mapped AHU SAT within sat_band of setpoint. Default confirm 30 min.
summary: Flags a chiller running while mapped zones or AHU SAT show the building is satisfied.

title: Missing FCU zone sensor
equation: Own zone setpoint is present while zone temperature is null for at least 90% of the window.
summary: Own zone setpoint is present while zone temperature is null for at least 90% of the window.

title: FCU heating coil under-delivery
equation: Fan on and heating valve ≥80%, but discharge air is less than 5.4°F above zone temperature.
summary: Fan on and heating valve ≥80%, but discharge air is less than 5.4°F above zone temperature.

title: FCU cooling coil under-delivery
equation: Fan on, cooling valve ≥80%, and heating shut, but discharge air is not below zone temperature.
summary: Fan on, cooling valve ≥80%, and heating shut, but discharge air is not below zone temperature.

title: FCU heating valve passing
equation: Fan on and both valves shut, but discharge air exceeds zone temperature by more than 5.4°F.
summary: Fan on and both valves shut, but discharge air exceeds zone temperature by more than 5.4°F.

title: FCU cooling valve passing
equation: Fan on and both valves shut, but zone temperature exceeds discharge air by more than 5.4°F.
summary: Fan on and both valves shut, but zone temperature exceeds discharge air by more than 5.4°F.

title: FCU damper command/position mismatch
equation: Fan on and damper command ≥15%, but feedback is more than 15 percentage points below command.
summary: Fan on and damper command ≥15%, but feedback is more than 15 percentage points below command.

title: FCU high CO2 with low outdoor-air command
equation: Fan on and valid CO₂ exceeds 1000 ppm while damper command remains below 10%.
summary: Fan on and valid CO₂ exceeds 1000 ppm while damper command remains below 10%.

title: FCU heat/cool deadband collapse
equation: Pass-through cooling setpoint minus heating setpoint is less than 1°C.
summary: Pass-through cooling setpoint minus heating setpoint is less than 1°C.

title: FCU heating/cooling mode cycling
equation: At least four heating/cooling valve mode changes occur in the analysis window.
summary: At least four heating/cooling valve mode changes occur in the analysis window.

title: Zone comfort band
equation: Zone temp outside zone_lo–zone_hi (default 70–75°F) during occupied hours when an occupancy column or Overview calendar is set (require_occupied, default on). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
summary: Flags occupied-band zone temperature violations.

title: Night setback miss
equation: Unoccupied AND zone temp > setback_hi (default 68°F) — heating setback not taken.
summary: Flags unoccupied zones that never drop into heating setback.

title: Excessive reheat during warm weather
equation: Air flowing AND OAT > 78°F AND reheat valve > 52%.
summary: Air flowing AND OAT > 78°F AND reheat valve > 52%.

title: Damper stuck at full open
equation: Air flowing AND damper > 97.5% sustained across the window.
summary: Air flowing AND damper > 97.5% sustained across the window.

title: Airflow sensor bias
equation: Airflow > 50 cfm while damper < 10% (implausible flow).
summary: Airflow > 50 cfm while damper < 10% (implausible flow).

title: Reheat when cooling available
equation: OAT < 65°F AND reheat valve > 25% (optional cooling-available must be true when mapped).
summary: Flags reheat while outdoor air is cool enough for free cooling.

title: Reheat valve stuck / no temp rise
equation: Air flowing AND reheat valve > 30% AND box discharge temp rises < 3°F above duct inlet (air from AHU) — stuck or failed reheat valve/coil.
summary: Flags reheat commanded open with airflow but almost no discharge temperature rise.

title: VAV leave vs parent AHU SAT (fedBy)
equation: Air flowing AND |VAV discharge − parent AHU SAT| > band. Needs package topology (vav_to_ahu) so ahu_sat is enriched from the fedBy AHU; otherwise SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES. Flags broken reheat, bad sensors, or rogue zones.
summary: Flags VAV discharge far from the parent AHU SAT when topology feeds are known.

title: Min airflow / fixed high flow
equation: Flow below min SP (when mapped), OR airflow stays flat (low rolling std) at a high mean while air is on (mins too high / box never modulates), OR min_flow_sp itself is excessively high.
summary: Flow below min SP (when mapped), OR airflow stays flat (low rolling std) at a high mean while air is on (mins too high / box never modulates), OR min_flow_sp itself is excessively high.

title: Low chilled-water ΔT
equation: Pump on AND (CHWR − CHWS) < 4°F.
summary: Pump on AND (CHWR − CHWS) < 4°F.

title: DP below SP at max pump speed
equation: Pump ≥ 87% AND CHW DP < DP SP − 2.2.
summary: Pump ≥ 87% AND CHW DP < DP SP − 2.2.

title: Plant supply temp outside deadband
equation: Pump on AND |CHWS − CHWS SP| > 2.2°F.
summary: Pump on AND |CHWS − CHWS SP| > 2.2°F.

title: Flow high at max pump
equation: Pump ≥ 87% AND CHW flow > 1100 gpm.
summary: Pump ≥ 87% AND CHW flow > 1100 gpm.

title: Discharge cold when heating
equation: Fan on, zone < 69°F, discharge SAT < 85°F.
summary: Fan on, zone < 69°F, discharge SAT < 85°F.

title: OA temperature spike
equation: OAT sample-to-sample jump > 16°F.
summary: OAT sample-to-sample jump > 16°F.

title: Condenser water not optimized vs wet-bulb
equation: CW supply significantly colder than web wet-bulb + design approach (Stull WB) — tower over-cooling / not optimized.
summary: Flags condenser water colder than wet-bulb + approach — tower over-cooling / not optimized.

title: High CW approach at full tower fan
equation: At full tower fan speed, leaving CW − web wet-bulb exceeds approach_max (default 8°F, typically 5–10°F). Suspect OA→wet-bulb / CW sensor mismatch or cooling-tower performance degradation.
summary: Flags high CW–wet-bulb approach at full tower fan — sensor mismatch or tower degradation.

title: Excess tower fan energy vs wet-bulb limit
equation: Tower fans at full speed while leaving CW is well above web wet-bulb + design approach (approach + excess_beyond). Fans are chasing a CW temp that is theoretically hard/impossible — excess fan energy.
summary: Flags full-speed tower fans while CW is well above theoretical WB+approach — excess fan energy.

title: Duct static trim advisory
equation: Duct static high (> 1.35 in.w.c.) while VAV pressure requests are low.
summary: Duct static high (> 1.35 in.w.c.) while VAV pressure requests are low.

title: HWST trim advisory
equation: HW supply > 160°F while reset requests are low.
summary: HW supply > 160°F while reset requests are low.

title: CHW plant reset advisory
equation: CHW supply < 45°F while reset requests are low.
summary: CHW supply < 45°F while reset requests are low.

title: Unoccupied runtime
equation: Fan running while occupancy is unoccupied (Overview calendar → occ_mode). When zone_t is mapped, also require zone inside comfort_low…comfort_high (defaults 21.1–23.9°C; synced from Overview zone band).
summary: Flags fan runtime during unoccupied hours from the Overview calendar.

title: Always-on fan or pump runtime
equation: Ranked proof (status/current > command) is on for ≥ always_on_pct of the window. Pressure is inferred runtime only and does not trip this rule ID.
summary: Flags fans or pumps that stay on for nearly the entire analysis window (24/7 runtime).

title: SAT reset not tracking outdoor air
equation: Fan on AND |SAT SP − (52 + 0.25×(OAT−65))| > 3°F.
summary: Flags SAT setpoint that is not tracking the outdoor-air reset curve.

title: Fan cmd/status mismatch
equation: Fan command and proven status disagree.
summary: Fan command and proven status disagree.

title: Low OA fraction
equation: Estimated OA fraction < 15% with adequate OAT/RAT split.
summary: Estimated OA fraction < 15% with adequate OAT/RAT split.

title: OA damper leakage
equation: Damper ≤ 5% but MAT tracks OAT within 2°F — leaking OA damper.
summary: Damper ≤ 5% but MAT tracks OAT within 2°F — leaking OA damper.

title: Cooling valve leakage
equation: Cooling valve ≤ 5% AND (SAT < sat_sp − sat_err OR SAT < MAT − mat_leak_delta). Fan proven on when fan_status/fan_cmd present (operational gate).
summary: Flags a closed cooling valve while SAT still looks like valve leakage.
